name: Ashplug Orders Report for Snappay
author: Ashkan Sohrevardi

sections.description:
Ashplug Orders Report for Snappay adds a focused admin report for WooCommerce stores that accept payments through a compatible Snappay payment gateway.

The plugin brings relevant Snappay orders together in one organized table, helping store administrators review order, transaction, payment, and customer information without changing WooCommerce order data.

Main features

  • Shows WooCommerce orders registered through the Snappay payment gateway
  • Displays customer, order number, order status, transaction reference, payment date, order amount, and payment status
  • Includes pagination for easier review of larger order lists
  • Displays the total number of Snappay orders in the store
  • Displays the date of the first recorded Snappay order
  • Highlights cancelled, fully refunded, and partially refunded paid orders with lightweight visual indicators
  • Includes English as the default language and Persian (fa_IR) translation files
  • Works as a read-only report and does not modify orders
  • Does not send store or order data to external services

This plugin is independently developed and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Snappay or WooCommerce.

Advanced features

A separate Pro plugin is available for advanced financial workflows, including installment schedules, commission calculations, Jalali date filters, settlement reports, and export tools.

More information is available on the Ashplug website.

No Pro plugin code is included in the version hosted on WordPress.org.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress Plugins screen, or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ashplug-orders-report-for-snappay/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce and a compatible Snappay payment gateway plugin are installed and active.
  4. In WordPress admin, open the Ashplug Snappay menu.
  5. Open Orders Report to review the available Snappay orders.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin modify WooCommerce orders?

No. The plugin provides a read-only report and does not modify order data or order statuses.

Does the plugin send order data to another service?

No. The report is generated inside WordPress and does not send store or order information to an external service.

Is WooCommerce required?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Is a Snappay payment gateway plugin required?

Yes. The report works with orders registered through a compatible Snappay payment gateway.

Which information is shown in the report?

The report can display customer information, order number, order status, transaction reference, payment date, order amount, and payment status.

How are cancelled and refunded orders displayed?

Paid orders that were later cancelled, fully refunded, or partially refunded are shown with lightweight visual indicators so they can be identified more easily.

Does the free plugin calculate installments, commission, or settlement amounts?

No. Those financial tools are available in a separate Pro plugin. The WordPress.org version focuses on the orders report.

Is this an official Snappay or WooCommerce plugin?

No. This plugin is independently developed and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Snappay or WooCommerce.

Where can I get support?

Please use the plugin support forum on WordPress.org for questions related to the free version.
